description: Line styles used on a planritning to encode the vertical position of a rörledning relative to the section at fönsternivå (window level). Critical for inferring elevation during mängdavtagning.

entries.meaning_en: Pipe runs below window level (within the room, visible in the section).
Pipe runs below the floor surface.
Pipe runs above window level but within the storey.
Pipe runs above the floor slab (i.e. in the storey above).
